blocked_analyses.reason: No trustworthy public historical coordinator/scheme assignment table is bundled across the full modelling window.
Public team/player inputs do not provide a consistent historical OL-unit quality measure comparable across 2019-2025.
Venue can be reconstructed, but attributing persistent tackle-credit effects to a stat crew requires an auditable official/scorer identifier rather than stadium name alone.
Public participation does not provide every eligible receiver's route/alignment/separation on every route; targeted-play separation cannot be used as if it were all-route target-earning evidence.
No consistent free historical individual double-team series is bundled for all pass rushers/receivers across the primary window.

current_season_automation.target_week_rule: all realized target-week rows excluded before feature generation

governance.rollback_rule: CONTROL hard-disables M5/M6 overrides without code changes

limitations: Empirical Step 28 results have not been generated yet.

methodology.step28: Second-wave signals must improve M4 OOS residuals in expanding-window holdouts; archetypes remain descriptive.
methodology.step29: Current features are built only from completed weeks before the target week and must satisfy history/coverage gates.
methodology.step30: AUTO promotes only when version, validation, scoring, freshness, leakage and eligibility checks all pass; CONTROL hard-disables overrides.
